title: Two-way communication systems.
officialText:
Where two-way Communication systems are provided to gain admittance to a building or
facility or to restricted areas within a building or facility, the system shall comply with ICC A117.1, including Section 708 (Two-
Way Communication Systems).
SECTION BC E106
TELEPHONES
